title.zh: 政府采购（质疑程序）条例 2002
title.vi: Quy chế Mua sắm Chính phủ (Thủ tục khiếu nại) 2002
title.th: ข้อบังคับการจัดซื้อจัดจ้างภาครัฐ (กระบวนพิจารณาคัดค้าน) 2002

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Government Procurement (Challenge Proceedings) Regulations 2002.
2. The fee payable to the Registrar of the Tribunal for bringing a challenge before the Tribunal is $500.
3. The sum to be deposited with the Registrar of the Tribunal under section 13 of the Act is $5,000.
